methodology.timing: optimized native binaries, no sanitizers/profilers or concurrent builds; nine samples in three alternating batches; excluded warm-up per build/batch
methodology.workloads: local TLS 1.3 and HTTP/2 incremental synthetic Anthropic SSE; 512-byte replies, 100 short turns, and three 65536-byte replies; full durable core/store/worker and actual 80x24 PTY
methodology.trust: 122 identical fixture anchors in bundle and hashed directory: all 121 current system roots plus one ephemeral local root; fake credentials; no provider network
methodology.memory: RSS/PSS/USS from smaps_rollup; terminal guardian measured separately; core allocator counters count backing allocations, not arena objects; DHAT/Massif measure optimized debug build without sanitizers
methodology.retained: no heap trimming, dlclose or disabled certificate/hostname verification; libcurl multi retains reusable connections
methodology.selected_samples: all startup/init/teardown and turns 1,2,3,100; intermediate 100-turn samples omitted here, retained in ignored raw outputs
methodology.limitations: RSS remains above 4-8 MiB with this system stack; PSS depends on concurrent library sharing. Local latency does not predict remote providers; final release uses different optimization flags and is separate from same-flag comparison.
